senses.sense_definition: A small, exclusive group of people who share common interests or purposes.

examples.text: The new junior employee joined our merry after-hours <w>coterie</w>.
A tightly knit <w>coterie</w> of executive powerbrokers made all the real decisions in the company.

senses.sense_definition: A communal burrow system inhabited by a group of prairie dogs.

examples.text: The <w>coterie</w> was located in the middle of our wheat field.
The population of each <w>coterie</w> constantly changes over a period of a few months or years.
